_comment: The Market (issue #112) and the satchel's size, in scripts/armory.gd. market.levels: per Market level, how many stalls the rotating stock fills and the highest gear tier traders bring. A trader on staff is needed for any of it. income: Gilt a day = per_level x level + the traders' Charm / charm_div + one for every provinces_per held provinces. rotation: the stock changes every this many days (on a seeded roll, so it is the same on reload). discount: 1% off Market prices per point of the traders' Charm, up to max_discount. pool: what can turn up: kinds picks what a stall holds by weight, then items (data/items.json, in stacks of qty), materials (data/materials.json, only from regions you have opened), gear (data/gear.json, tiers up to the level's tier, never hero weapons: those come from the Forge). Each stall holds one stack; buy as much of it as you like. sell_rate: share of a material's value the Market pays. satchel: the satchel's total size (base) and the Forge-made upgrades that add to it.
